data.one_liner: Flutter plugin wrapping Pendo's native SDK for in-app surveys and analytics.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart interface to Pendo's native iOS and Android SDKs, enabling tracking of user behavior and delivery of in-app surveys, guides, and announcements. It exposes methods such as setup, startSession, and setDebugMode to interact with the Pendo platform.
use_when: You need to track user behavior and deliver targeted in-app experiences
You already use Pendo for product analytics and want a Flutter integration
avoid_when: You require a cross-platform analytics solution that does not depend on a Pendo account
You need a fully open-source or self-hosted analytics SDK
strengths: Real-time data collection and in-app messaging
Comprehensive API coverage for Pendo features
weaknesses: Limited to Pendo platform; requires a Pendo account
No support for other analytics providers
Documentation is minimal and mostly links to external resources
data.setup_notes: Follow the iOS and Android installation instructions linked in the README. No build_runner or code generation required.
